content: In the second subsection of Nafsat I, per Melvin-Koushki, the fifth item is Ibn ʿAbbās's exposition of Q 2:269 that all wisdom is contained in the Quran, supported by a khabar of Ḥusayn b. ʿAlī on the letters KHYʿṢ (Q 19:1): “Were I to tell you the meaning of these letters you would be able to walk on water.”
